name: Nature Organic
tagline: Forest, moss and a lime sun that keeps growing.
description: Identity film for brands rooted in land and long horizons: deep forest green, signal lime and mint paper, real nature photography collaged with collateral, a contemporary serif with a grotesk companion, and a radiating sunburst of lime bars as the motion idea. Opens on a moodboard that resolves into one photograph, then a softer rhythmic montage.

signature: moodboard grid resolves into one full-bleed photograph (seamless zoom into a tile)
radiance: lime bars grow outward from the mark, a forest disc opens behind them and becomes the next scene
a softer rhythmic montage (cuts every 5–7 frames) of collateral, ending by pulling back out of a tile into the grid
avoid: stock-nature clichés (sunrise lens flares, drone swoops)

camera: Gentle and natural: slow push-ins on photography, a seamless zoom into and out of moodboard tiles, nothing handheld; holds breathe with a 1–3 % drift.

texture.notes: Real nature photography (moss, bark, hills, leaf macro), uncoated paper, embossing, wood; soft natural light. Fine grain, no gloss.

lighting: Soft overcast or low morning sun, misty depth; collateral lit like a still-life on a table.
sound: Warm organic percussion (wood, shaker, soft claps) at ~100–115 BPM, air and birdsong beds, a rising shimmer under the sunburst; never synthetic risers.

beats.label: Moodboard: the brand's world around the mark
Seamless zoom into the hills tile
Bars radiate, the forest disc opens, 'of Growth' rises
Soft montage, then pull back out of the moss tile to the board

motionSummary: Moves like growth: a moodboard breathes, the camera sinks into one photograph, lime bars radiate out of the mark as a forest disc opens behind them, a soft montage of collateral, then the camera drifts back out to the board.

composition: open wide on a loose moodboard cluster around the mark, generous mint space between tiles
one photograph becomes the frame; the mark keeps the place it had in the tile
the sunburst is centred on the mark or rises from a corner; headlines crop off an edge
collateral laid like a still-life (cards on bark, books, chips), slight angles, never a 3D fly-through
visual.shapeLanguage: rounded tiles and chips (14–36 px radius), circles and discs, radiating butt-ended bars of alternating lengths, the seed-shaped mark
visual.contrast: soft natural photography against flat forest and lime; lime is light (bars, chips, the mark on dark), forest is ground, mint is paper; no glow

grammar.pacing: patient: long camera moves (20–30 frames) and holds of 1–2 s, with one softer montage section that cuts every 5–7 frames
grammar.rhythm: smooth on ones; continuous camera between beats, a gentle beat-cut only in the montage
grammar.easing: camera moves on a long ease-in-out (ease.camera); growth eases out (ease.enter) and keeps creeping; discs open with ease.morph; tiles settle with springs.leaf, never bouncy
grammar.acceleration: organic: things start almost imperceptibly, swell, and keep moving slowly instead of stopping (bars turn ≤0.15°/frame on holds, photos push 1–3 %)
movement: seamless fixed-point zoom into a moodboard tile and back out of another
radiance: bars growing outward from the mark, staggered by length
circular disc matte opening behind the bars
cropped serif headline rising from the bottom edge
tiles settling in a stagger (fast arrival, long settle)
grammar.density: medium-low: one growth idea at a time, with a slow ambient move (push, turn) underneath
grammar.holds: every hold breathes: a 1–3 % push or a slow turn of the sun; nothing in this style is fully still

transitionPresets.name: Zoom into the tile
transitionPresets.bridge: a 16:9 photo tile on the moodboard
transitionPresets.build: fixed-point log zoom about the point that maps the tile onto the frame; the tile grows straight into full bleed with no drift and the mark lands where it sat in the tile
transitionPresets.sound: a soft air swell under the move, birdsong rising

transitionPresets.name: Radiance disc
transitionPresets.bridge: the mark at the centre of the photograph
transitionPresets.build: lime bars grow outward from the mark (ease.enter, staggered by length) while a forest disc opens behind them (ease.morph) and becomes the poster ground; the mark flips to mint on the disc
transitionPresets.sound: a rising shimmer that blooms as the disc fills

transitionPresets.name: Rise handover
transitionPresets.bridge: the outward motion of the bars
transitionPresets.build: as the bars finish growing, a cropped serif headline rises from the bottom edge on the same ease, carrying the energy into type
transitionPresets.sound: a warm wooden knock as the headline settles

transitionPresets.name: Soft montage
transitionPresets.bridge: the mark's consistent placement and the lime
transitionPresets.build: hard cuts every 5–7 frames through collateral stills (type specimen, numerals in lime chips, lime field, embossed card), alternating light and dark grounds; never faster than 4 frames
transitionPresets.sound: a soft wooden knock or shaker on each cut, 100–115 BPM

transitionPresets.name: Radius match
transitionPresets.bridge: a round form of the same radius
transitionPresets.build: hard cut from the sunburst disc to a round object of the same radius in the same place (enamel pin, round chip, the sun)

transitionPresets.name: Pull back to the board
transitionPresets.bridge: a full-bleed photo that is one of the board's tiles
transitionPresets.build: cut to a photo that is a tile at full zoom, then reverse the fixed-point zoom out to the moodboard while the other tiles settle in from below in a stagger
transitionPresets.sound: a long exhale of air, birdsong settling

archetypes.name: Moodboard cluster
archetypes.purpose: show the brand's whole world at once
archetypes.composition: loose cluster of photo tiles, lime and forest chips with numerals, an 'Aa' tile and wood, the mark with a tiny sun at its heart, mint space between
archetypes.elements: photo tiles, chips (96%, $4.2B, 12k ha), type tile, the mark, a mono label
archetypes.motion: tiles settle in a stagger; the little sun breathes; otherwise still

archetypes.name: Full-bleed photograph
archetypes.purpose: ground the brand in real land
archetypes.composition: one nature photograph (hills, moss, bark, leaf) full bleed, the mark small on it where it sat in the tile, the name below
archetypes.elements: photo, the mark, the name in the serif
archetypes.motion: a slow 2–4 % push; the name rises softly

archetypes.name: Radiance poster
archetypes.purpose: the identity's big idea: growth radiating from the mark
archetypes.composition: forest disc filling the frame, lime bars radiating from the mark at centre, a cropped serif headline ('of Growth') along the bottom, a grotesk line at top-left
archetypes.elements: sunburst bars, the mark in mint, headline, one sentence
archetypes.motion: bars grow then keep turning slowly; headline rises; hold breathes

archetypes.name: Collateral still
archetypes.composition: one piece of collateral per shot: type specimen, a numeral in a lime chip on forest, a lime field with a corner sunburst, an embossed card on bark
archetypes.elements: the mark in its usual place, numerals in chips, specimen type
archetypes.motion: none inside the shot in a montage; a 1–2 % drift when held

archetypes.name: Radiant lockup
archetypes.composition: the mark and 'Meadowline' on forest or lime, the sun's bars around it turning slowly, one line of copy
archetypes.motion: bars grow a last time and keep turning; line rises; long hold

beats.purpose: the brand's world in one look
beats.motion: tiles settle around the mark; a breath of stillness
the tile becomes the frame; slow push; the name appears
bars grow out of the mark, the forest disc opens, the headline rises (rise-handover) and holds, turning
collateral every 5–7 frames, then one breathing hold
the round chip matches into the lockup; bars turn; or pull back out of a tile to the board

sequence.cutRhythm: mostly continuous: zooms and mattes carry the big changes; one soft montage cuts every 5–7 frames on a warm 100–115 BPM pulse; never faster than 4 frames, never a crossfade

scenes.action: photo tiles, 96% / $4.2B / 12k ha chips and an 'Aa' tile settle around the Meadowline mark; its little sun breathes
the camera sinks into the hills tile until it is the frame; the mark sits on the hills, 'Meadowline' rises
lime bars grow out of the mark, the forest disc opens, 'of Growth' rises cropped along the bottom; hold, turning
type specimen, 96% chip on forest, lime field with corner sunburst, card on bark — a cut every 6 frames, then a 1 s hold on the 96% chip
the round chip matches into the sun; mark + 'Meadowline' + 'Capital that grows back'; bars turn; hold 2 s

elements.text: serif headlines rise from the bottom edge and stay cropped; grotesk sentences fade-rise softly; mono labels are static
elements.logo: the mark keeps its place from tile to photo to poster; it never moves on its own, the world grows around it; it flips colour (lime ↔ mint) as the disc passes
elements.icons: none; numerals in lime chips do that job
elements.images: real nature photography (hills, moss, bark, leaf macro), untinted, soft light; enters by zoom, breathes with a slow push
elements.ui: rare: a social profile or a site as one more collateral still
elements.shapes: rounded tiles and chips that settle in a stagger; discs that open as mattes; radiating bars that grow and slowly turn
elements.background: mint paper or forest ground; photography as the frame; never a gradient wash

audio.sync: zooms and the disc ride long swells (they start before the beat and bloom on it); montage cuts on 8ths of a warm 100–115 BPM groove; holds sit on air and birdsong
audio.sfx: wood blocks, shakers, soft claps, an air swell under zooms, a rising shimmer under the radiance, a soft wooden knock per montage cut
